sloka: न चास्मिन् प्रतिवक्तव्यः सीतां प्रति कथञ्चन ।तस्मात्त्वं गच्छ सौमित्रे नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।। ७.४५.१९ ॥
transliteration: na cāsmin prativaktavyaḥ sītāṁ prati kathañcana ।tasmāttvaṁ gaccha saumitre nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।। 7.45.19 ॥

translations.english: And regarding Sita, you must not argue against this command in any way; therefore, O Lakshmana, go, for no deliberation is to be done in this matter.
